title: [Chapitre] IV. Analysis situs (première mouture) : notes manuscrites (10/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (pp. 25-28): a 'figure' F is a finite set of closed subsets ('closed strata', typically manifolds such as connected varieties) of an ambient space E, ordered by inclusion. It satisfies admissibility conditions. For each X in F, the boundary dX is the union of the Y in F_{<X} and the open stratum is X° = X minus dX, which must be non-empty. For X, Y in F, X∩Y is the union of the Z in F with Z ≤ X and Z ≤ Y. The open strata X° then partition the support |F| (p. 26, Cor. 2).

Cor. 3 (this page): let F be a figure and F' ⊂ F a 'saturated' subset of the ordered set (F, ⊂), meaning downward closed: X, Y ∈ F, Y ∈ F', X ≤ Y ⇒ X ∈ F'. Then F' is again a figure, called a sub-figure (sous-figure) of F. Sub-figures of F correspond bijectively to order ideals (downward-closed subsets, i.e. the closed sets of the Alexandrov topology) of the poset F.

Warning: if F' and F are two figures with F' ⊂ F, F' need not be a sub-figure. Counterexample from the 'exemple-type': F = {X0 ⊂ X1}, with X1 a connected manifold and X0 a closed sub-thing. F' = {X1} is a figure but not downward closed. The margin notes that here F' ⊂ F, F' ≠ F, yet the two have the same underlying set |F'| = |F| = X1. So the stratified set is determined by the figure, not by the support.

Notation: F' ≤ F for 'F' is a sub-figure of F'; this is an order relation on figures. A crossed-out start ('F, G compatibles si F ∪ G est ...') leads to p. 28, which treats compatibility of figures and 'configurations' (families of pairwise compatible figures).

Purpose: building the elementary combinatorics of stratified 'tame' spaces (closed unions of strata) for the 1986 Analysis situs chapter.
errors: In the definition of saturation the conclusion is written 'X ∈ F'; it should read 'X ∈ F'' (a slip of the pen — otherwise the condition is vacuous).
Proof is omitted but immediate. For X ∈ F' one has F'_{<X} = F_{<X}, so dX and X° are unchanged. The intersection condition also persists, since every Z ≤ X lies in F'.

ideas.what: Sub-figure = downward-closed subset of the stratum poset; it is again a figure (closed union of strata is a stratified subspace).
ideas.modern_name: closed union of strata / closed subcomplex; order ideal in the stratification (face) poset, Alexandrov topology
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard in stratification theory (Whitney, Thom, Mather) and combinatorial topology (face posets of regular CW complexes)
ideas.where_published: Not in published texts; Esquisse d'un programme §5-6 only sketches 'topologie modérée' and stratified structures

ideas.what: Warning that inclusion of figures is not the sub-figure relation; same support with different stratifications (X0 ⊂ X1 vs {X1}).
ideas.modern_name: stratification is extra structure on the space; refinement vs closed substratified subset

ideas.what: Order relation F' ≤ F on figures (sub-figure), preparing compatibility/configurations on the next page.

deep.surprise_reason: Elementary, correct bookkeeping lemma about closed unions of strata in Grothendieck's stratified 'figures'. The broader 1986 Analysis situs project is of historical interest, but this page contains nothing beyond standard material.
transcription_corrections: 'dans F' est une figure' should be 'alors F' est une figure'.
The image has 'X ∈ F' after the implication (author's slip for X ∈ F').
Margin: 'les mêmes variétés les plus basses' is doubtful. It likely says F', F have the same union/support (|F'| = |F|) — 'ont même réunion' / 'mêmes points' — since F' = {X1} lacks X0.
'(Ce[?] le cas de l'exemple-type' is probably '(Cf. le cas de l'exemple-type'.
